## RecCheck 1.1.1 — Windows

Nightly POS receipt audit for the protel checkcharge1 report (.oxps). Everything runs locally — no data leaves the machine.

### New in 1.1

From this version on, even engine updates arrive through the blue ↑ button inside the app — downloaded from GitHub in the background and installed silently in one click. This is the last installer you download by hand.

The app now opens to a **main menu**: *Compare* (opens the night's reports), *Language* (full English/Greek interface), *Change Directory*, and *Help* (opens the support page). Point it once at the folder where protel saves the reports and every pull appears in a click-to-open list or tile view — no more browsing for files. If the report you have open changes on disk (a fresh pull), the app asks whether to load the live version or keep the one you're checking.

### Install

Download **RecCheck-Setup.exe** below (under *Assets*) and open it. It installs in a few seconds — no administrator password — and puts **RecCheck** on the Desktop and in the Start Menu. Updating from 1.0: just run it, everything is kept.

If Windows shows a blue *"Windows protected your PC"* screen: click **More info → Run anyway** (the app is unsigned, not harmful).

Tool updates keep arriving inside the app (blue ↑ button) — no reinstall needed for those.
